name: 19422 · Blue Bell, PA
findings: ZIP 19422 (Blue Bell) has 153 nonprofit organizations. 66 of them (43%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 63 organizations.
Housing organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (31% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 19422 (Blue Bell) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
26% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
